newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent quiet, NYMEX steady, watching weather.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent quiet, NYMEX steady, watching weather.

text.p: Brent crude futures were marking time on Tuesday ahead of the New Year break, while NYMEX crude futures were steady from their New York close.
February Brent trading on SIMEX were offered at $23.80 per barrel after London added 27 cents to settle at $23.69. There was no bid by midday.
NYMEX crude meanwhile was last traded on ACCESS at $25.36 per barrel, down just one cent from the New York settlement.
London gas oil futures led the oil complex on Monday as a cold snap in Europe sparked a buying spree. January gas oil gained $6.00 per tonne to $223.00.
Brokers said Asian trading was largely marking time ahead of Europe and North America.
The weather would continue to dominate the markets.
NYMEX January heating oil was down just 0.02 cent at 70.55 cents per gallon on ACCESS, after adding just 0.02 cent in New York.
Brent trading on SIMEX closes at 1600 hours (0800 GMT) on Tuesday to account for the New Year holiday.
